column1: # Forgeroom performance baseline (roadmap M9.5); medians of 3 run(s) per scene, 330 frames each, the first 30 not measured
# Machine: Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26300 amd64, 8 processors; Java 21 (Gradle toolchain); the GPU is in each row
# Frame times wait for the GPU to finish (glFinish), so vsync does not hide them; heap is the Java heap only, not native memory
# Recorded 2026-11-18 in three sessions the same way (the first was stopped by the host for low memory after 7 scenes); scenes/Large.json is the M3.8 large map, engine-desktop/build/m3-8-large-map
